about.title: Asia’s arena for mobile esports.
about.body: BattleAsia is a tournament platform for PUBG, Free Fire, COD, and MLBB. Players buy BAC, join paid matches, and cash out winnings. Live counts on this page come from the same database as Admin — empty means empty, never a fake headline.
about.p1: Paid rooms with hidden credentials until start
about.p2: BAC wallet, shop, transfer, and withdrawals
about.p3: Referral is one-level only — deposit commission, not MLM

auth.promo.lead: Daily solo, duo and squad matches with verified rooms, instant results and secure cash payouts. Registration takes under a minute.

wallet.title: BAC hub
shop.title: Buy BAC
shop.lead: Coin packs and manual deposit. Same account as the arena — this tab signed in separately.
faq.fair.a: No cheats, emulators where banned, teaming, or account sharing. Reports go to support with screenshot proof. Confirmed fair-play hits can ban the account and void a match.
faq.ops.a: Join before the lobby fills. Room ID and password release at start for paid participants only. Leave before start refunds the entry fee. After start, the seat is locked.
faq.prizes.a: Winnings are paid in BAC after admin result verification. Prize split follows the match card (placement / per-kill). Never trust a client-submitted result as payout truth.
faq.pay.a: Buy BAC via bKash, Nagad, or crypto. Deposits wait for admin approval. Withdrawals follow the 70% match-bet withdrawable rule and Admin payout review.
